summary.tldr: Removes two Criminal Code defences for wilfully promoting hatred or antisemitism when the argument is based on a religious subject or religious text.
what_it_does: Repeals the defence in the Criminal Code that applies when a person, in good faith, expresses or tries to support an opinion on a religious subject while facing a charge of wilful promotion of hatred.

Repeals the defence that applies when a person, in good faith, expresses or tries to support an opinion based on a belief in a religious text while facing a charge of wilful promotion of antisemitism.
summary.background: The bill amends section 319 of the Criminal Code. It removes the defences set out in paragraphs 319(3)(b) and 319(3.1)(b).
